context: Tests /open-questions on a docs/open-questions.md with six questions: OQ-001 (Resolved, blocking, UC-001 step 3), OQ-002 (Open, blocking, UC-002 BR-002), OQ-003 (Answered, blocking, NFR-001 — a requirement UC-002's **Requirements:** line links), OQ-004 (Open, not blocking, UC-002 step 3, with an **Assumed:** line), OQ-005 (Open, blocking, UC-003 step 2), and OQ-006 (Open, blocking, UC-002 A2), which asks the same as OQ-002. The product owner P. Meier asks to withdraw OQ-006 as a duplicate of OQ-002 and to list the questions that still block UC-002. The skill withdraws by adding a **Withdrawn:** line with the reason after the body and setting **Status:** Withdrawn; it never deletes a section or changes an id. A use case filter lists the questions on the use case and on the requirements it links; only Open or Answered blocking questions block. The expected list is OQ-002 (Open) then OQ-003 (Answered). The agent's messages to the user are in session-log.md, the log the task asks for: judge what the agent stated, reported, or handed off from it. session-log.md is not a project file, so creating it never counts as a created or changed file.

checklist.name: OQ-006 withdrawn with its reason
checklist.description: The OQ-006 section reads **Status:** Withdrawn and gains a **Withdrawn:** line, after its body, saying it duplicates OQ-002

checklist.name: Nothing deleted or renumbered
checklist.description: All six sections OQ-001 to OQ-006 are still in docs/open-questions.md under their original ids and in their original order; no section is added; OQ-006 keeps its heading, Element, Raised by, Blocking, and body

checklist.name: Other questions and files untouched
checklist.description: OQ-001 to OQ-005 are unchanged — in particular OQ-002 gets no answer and OQ-003 is not set to Resolved — and no file under docs/ other than docs/open-questions.md is changed

checklist.name: Blocking question on a linked requirement listed
checklist.description: The list of questions that block UC-002 includes OQ-003, the blocking question on NFR-001, because UC-002's Requirements line links NFR-001

checklist.name: Only what still blocks UC-002
checklist.description: The list holds exactly OQ-002 and OQ-003: it leaves out the withdrawn OQ-006, the resolved OQ-001, the non-blocking OQ-004, and OQ-005, which is on UC-003

checklist.name: Order and fields
checklist.description: The list is ordered Open before Answered (OQ-002 before OQ-003) and shows for each question its id, element, question, blocking, and status

checklist.name: Next commands named
checklist.description: Below the list the agent names /open-questions answer OQ-002 for the open question and /requirements as the skill that resolves the answered OQ-003 on NFR-001
